title: Statuses become Available, Verified and Announced
description:
Replace the verdicts shipped, verified, pending and vapor with three neutral statuses:
- **Available**: anyone can use it today.
- **Verified**: Available, and an editor checked the evidence.
- **Announced**: claimed, not yet usable or not yet confirmed.

Changes:
- Update `web/scoring.json` verdicts and the stamp marks in `web/hooks.py` (`_stamp_html`), using the shapes from the Tokens artboard (https://claude.ai/artifact/EoXGtpzsayij4d7tmrfZ9r). They must be distinguishable without colour.
- Migrate the verdict on all 70 published items through the CMS publish path: shipped → available, pending → announced, vapor → announced. Keep `verdictBy` and `verdictAt`.
- Update the "How to read a row" status key on home and the stamp lines on Submit and sign-in.

Acceptance:
- Every item page shows one of the three words.
- No page contains the old status words.
- Item Markdown versions match their pages.
